description: This file defines the 'NodeApp' class, which extends Android's Application class. It initializes application-wide preferences, manages a singleton instance of 'NodeRuntime', and configures strict mode policies during development for debugging purposes.

classes.name: NodeApp
classes.description: Custom Application class that manages runtime initialization and debugging policies.

methods.name: ensureRuntime
methods.description: Initializes and returns the singleton NodeRuntime instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: peekRuntime
methods.description: Returns the current NodeRuntime instance if it exists, without initializing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the Application's onCreate method to set strict mode policies during debug builds.
